objective: Fix low-resolution deck image recognition and prevent mutated/incorrect card names from being auto-added to purchase search rows.

evidence.rootCause: Prompt allowed search-term localization, normalization auto-added low-confidence guesses, and conflicts were deduped only by final searchTerm.
evidence.promptFix: Recognition now instructs OCR-first behavior, exact readable-title preservation, unresolved on uncertainty, and no duplicate searchTerm values for the same sourceName.
evidence.normalizationFix: Low-confidence guesses move to unresolved and same-sourceName conflicts keep only the highest-confidence candidate.
evidence.frontendFix: Small screenshots are upscaled to a 1200px long edge before upload processing.
evidence.reproduction: The low-resolution synthetic deck image no longer returned the previous incorrect duplicate/mutated rows.

knownLimitations: Images with no readable title still rely on visual model inference, but low-confidence candidates are no longer auto-added.
Preserving English visible names prevents wrong Korean mutations, but a future verified card-name dictionary would improve Korean shop search terms safely.
